'''Poyle''' was a [[human]] who worked for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] as a [[lieutenant]]<ref name="Who Else Knows?" /> around [[1 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{AndorDate|211}}</ref> When [[Cassian Jeron Andor]] and [[Ruescott Melshi]] left the [[Great Temple|Rebel base]] on [[Yavin 4]] without permission to rescue [[Kleya Marki]] on [[Coruscant]], Poyle briefed [[Davits Draven]] regarding Andor's unauthorized leave,<ref name="Who Else Knows?" /> and again briefed Draven, along with [[Mon Mothma]] and [[Bail Prestor Organa]], upon Andor's return to base.<ref name="Kyber">{{Andor|Jedha, Kyber, Erso}}</ref> For aiding in the unauthorized departure of Andor and Melshi from the base, Poyle confined [[Wilmon Paak]] to his quarters on Draven's orders.<ref name="Who Else Knows?" />

==Behind the scenes==
Poyle was portrayed by [[Terique Jarrett]] in the live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', first appearing in "[[Who Else Knows?]]" and "[[Jedha, Kyber, Erso]]," the eleventh and twelfth episodes of the show's [[Andor Season 2|second season]],<ref name="Who Else Knows?" /><ref name="Kyber" /> both of which aired on [[May 14]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref> The character's name is not spoken in the episodes but is listed in the credits.<ref name="Who Else Knows?" /><ref name="Kyber" />
